# All Files Converter

> Free online file converters that run 100% in your browser. No uploads, no sign-up, no watermarks, no accounts.

## What this site is

All Files Converter (https://allfilesconverter.vercel.app/) is a free file-conversion website. Every tool converts files entirely on the visitor's device using web technology (Canvas, WebAssembly, File API). There is no server-side processing, no database and no user accounts.

## Privacy / no-upload policy

- Files never leave the visitor’s device. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
- No server processes files; there is no database and no user accounts.
- Conversions are free forever with no watermarks and no sign-up.
- The "Summarize this page with AI" buttons only share the page\u2019s public summary text with the chosen AI — never the visitor\u2019s files.

## Flagship tools

- https://allfilesconverter.vercel.app/gif-maker/ — Video to GIF Maker: trim, set width/FPS/quality, two-pass palette rendering, no watermark.
- https://allfilesconverter.vercel.app/convert/heic-to-jpg/ — HEIC to JPG Converter (iPhone photos to universal JPG).
- https://allfilesconverter.vercel.app/convert/mp4-to-mp3/ — MP4 to MP3 Converter (extract 192 kbps audio from video).
